profile_text.body:
Pika Labs operates pika.art and describes itself as an AI creative platform. Its site says the platform is comprehensive and simple, with outputs that meet user standards. The company's own text presents a model that turns video into a synchronized, full-scene soundscape, including motion-aware sound effects, voice, music, and ambience that follow the action. It also describes a new music generation model for turning creative direction into finished tracks from text, lyrics, a reference voice, an existing track, or any combination.
